attractions.name: Spituk Monastery & Kali Mata Temple
attractions.description: Active hilltop Buddhist monastery dating to the 11th century with views over the Indus Valley, airport and mountains. Contains a fierce protector deity also revered by Hindus as Kali Mata.
attractions.dress_code: Dress modestly, particularly when entering prayer halls
tips: Keep quiet and respectful; it is an active monastery
Some areas may be closed during religious activities
Approach involves steps; take it slowly at altitude
Enjoy the hilltop views beyond the main prayer hall
